Title: Azure Support Plan Offer extended to December 31, 2023

Body.Content:
The existing Azure Support offer is being extended. Beginning July 1, 2023, all new and renewing Azure customers who purchase an Enterprise Agreement (EA or EES) or are part of the field-led Microsoft Customer Agreement (MCA) will receive free Azure Standard support.  Qualifications for the promotion will end on December 31, 2023.  

This offer is designed for customers who buy Microsoft Azure services on an Enterprise Agreement. It provides an additional level of access to expert technical support from Microsoft to help customers with their cloud journey and comes at no additional charge. 

There is no action for existing customers. Your customers can view promo terms posted here. The webpage update will be visible on July 1, 2023.
